spec2def(loadperf.dll loadperf.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# loadperf.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/loadperf-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(loadperf_shims OBJECT loadperf_main.c stubs.c)
target_link_libraries(loadperf_shims PRIVATE wine libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(loadperf_shims)
add_cargo_module(loadperf loadperf-cargo loadperf.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS loadperf_shims psdk)
